summary.en: As of 09:00 EST, equity futures were lower versus their own Thursday 16:00 EST readings, with S&P 500 futures down 0.85%, Nasdaq-100 futures down 1.61% and Dow futures down 0.28%. That follows a sixth straight cash-session loss for the S&P 500, which closed down 1.98% Thursday and dropped below its 200-day average this week. The 10-year Treasury yield and the U.S. Dollar Index eased, Ross Stores raised full-year EPS guidance, and the November Michigan consumer sentiment reading was scheduled for 10:00 EST.
summary.zh: 截至美东时间09:00，三大股指期货较各自周四16:00的报价均下跌，标普500期货跌0.85%，纳指100期货跌1.61%，道指期货跌0.28%。标普500现货指数周四收跌1.98%，连续第六个交易日下跌，本周跌破200日均线。10年期美债收益率和美元指数走低，Ross Stores上调全年每股收益指引，密歇根大学11月消费者信心终值定于美东时间10:00发布。

title.en: S&P 500 extends losing streak to six sessions as holiday spending comes into focus
title.zh: 标普500连续六个交易日下跌，假日消费成为市场焦点

impact.en: The S&P 500 fell 1.98% to 7,177.56 Thursday. Reuters reported that it slipped below its 200-day average this week for the first time since April and was roughly 8% below its October 6 high. Anthropic rose 17% on its trading debut while major indexes fell. Oxford Economics forecasts 4.2% holiday retail sales growth, or 2.2% after inflation, excluding autos, gasoline, bars and restaurants.
impact.zh: 标普500周四跌1.98%至7,177.56点。据路透社报道，该指数本周自4月以来首次跌破200日均线，较10月6日高点低约8%。Anthropic上市首日上涨17%，同期主要股指下跌。牛津经济研究院预计假日零售销售额增4.2%，扣除通胀后增2.2%，不含汽车、汽油及餐饮。

bullish: October core retail sales rose faster than expected, Reuters reported. The holiday sales forecast offers a separate test of demand. / 据路透社报道，10月核心零售销售增速高于预期。假日销售将提供另一项需求检验。
bearish: Reuters reported that technology shares were down nearly 19% from their level at the S&P 500’s October 6 high. / 据路透社报道，科技板块较标普500在10月6日见顶时的水平跌近19%。

macroRisk.en: Next week’s inflation data and updated third-quarter GDP estimate may change the growth and rate outlook heading into the shortened Thanksgiving trading week.
macroRisk.zh: 感恩节交易周较短，下周通胀数据和第三季度GDP更新可能改变市场对经济增长与利率的判断。

title.en: Dollar index declines ahead of 10:00 EST sentiment and state jobs data
title.zh: 美元指数走低，10:00待公布消费者信心及各州就业数据

impact.en: The U.S. Dollar Index was 103.67 at 08:55 EST, down 0.21% from its Thursday 16:00 reading. The Federal Reserve’s prepared text for Christopher Waller’s 08:25 EST welcome at the College Fed Challenge Finals outlined policy deliberation and communication without giving a new rate view. Michigan’s final November consumer sentiment reading and October state unemployment data were scheduled for 10:00 EST.
impact.zh: 美东时间08:55，美元指数报103.67，较周四16:00的报价跌0.21%。美联储公布了沃勒于08:25在大学联储挑战赛决赛致欢迎辞的讲稿，内容涉及政策审议与沟通，未提出新的利率观点。11月密歇根大学消费者信心终值与10月各州失业数据定于10:00发布。

macroRisk.en: The 10:00 releases follow the cash open. Compare them with expectations and watch whether Treasury yields and rate-sensitive shares move in the same direction afterward.
macroRisk.zh: 10:00的数据在现货开盘后公布。届时关注数据与预期的差异，以及随后美债收益率和利率敏感股是否同向变化。

title.en: Ross Stores reports 8% comparable sales growth and raises fiscal 2026 EPS outlook
title.zh: Ross Stores同店销售增长8%，上调2026财年每股收益指引

impact.en: Ross Stores (ROST) reported Thursday at 16:01 EST that third-quarter sales rose 12% year over year to $6.3B and EPS came in at $1.91 versus $1.58 a year earlier. It raised fiscal 2026 EPS guidance to $8.75–$8.84, including an approximately $0.60 per-share benefit from tariff refunds booked in the second quarter.
impact.zh: Ross Stores（ROST）周四美东时间16:01公布，第三季度销售额同比增12%至$6.3B，每股收益由上年同期$1.58升至$1.91。公司将2026财年每股收益指引上调至$8.75–$8.84，其中包含第二季度确认的关税退款带来的约$0.60每股收益。

bullish: Management attributed most comparable sales growth to store traffic. Operating margin rose 70 basis points to 12.3%. / 管理层表示同店销售增长主要由客流带动。营业利润率上升70个基点至12.3%。

macroRisk.en: The company retained its 4%–5% comparable sales growth forecast for the fourth quarter. One discount retailer’s results offer a limited read on broader holiday demand.
macroRisk.zh: 公司维持第四季度同店销售增长4%–5%的预测。一家折扣零售商的业绩对整体假日需求的参考范围有限。

note.en: The premarket signals a cautious start. Nasdaq-100 futures are down 1.61%, compared with a 0.28% decline in Dow futures, each measured against its own Thursday 16:00 EST reading. The 10-year yield fell 8.4 basis points to 4.968% from Thursday’s 15:00 reading, and the dollar index is down 0.21% from Thursday at 16:00. Lower yields may ease pressure on valuations, yet Nasdaq-100 futures are still lagging. The 2.72% drop in gold futures adds a conflicting signal. If selling broadens after the cash open at 09:30 EST even as yields stay lower, the cautious view strengthens. If semiconductor shares recover and participation improves, it weakens.
note.zh: 盘前信号显示，开盘仍需谨慎。纳指100期货跌1.61%，道指期货跌0.28%，均较各自周四16:00 EST的报价计算。10年期收益率较周四15:00回落8.4个基点至4.968%，美元指数较周四16:00跌0.21%。收益率走低可能缓解估值压力，但纳指100期货仍落后。黄金期货下跌2.72%，进一步凸显跨资产信号的分歧。若09:30 EST开盘后，即使收益率仍处较低水平，跌势也向更多板块蔓延，则谨慎判断得到加强。若半导体股回升、市场上涨家数扩大，则削弱这一判断。
